item.title: Air Force explains why its chief accompanied Tinubu to Turkey
item.description: The Nigerian Air Force has said the Chief of Air staff, Air Marshal Sunday accompanied President Tinubu and Minister of Defence (HMOD), General Christopher Gwabin Musa, to Turkiye as parts of operational efforts, particularly in the fight against terrorism, banditry, insurgency, and other asymmetric threats. Air Commodore Ehimen Ejodame, Director of Public Relations and Information, […] Air Force explains why its chief accompanied Tinubu to Turkey

item.title: FCT workers defy Wike’s orders, resume strike
item.description: Workers of the Federal Capital Territory Administration, FCTA, under the Joint Union Action Committee, JUAC, resumed their indefinite strike on Thursday, which they initially began on January 19 over unresolved welfare concerns. The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) observed that only a few workers were present across FCTA secretariats, departments and agencies, a stark contrast […] FCT workers defy Wike’s orders, resume strike

item.title: Call for INEC chairman’s resignation political, don’t hide under religion – CAN tells Shari’ah Council
item.description: The Christian Association of Nigeria, CAN, in Northern States has advised Shari’ah Council to openly identify any individual or group behind the campaign against the INEC chairman, insisting that religious platforms must not be used as “cheap cover” to pursue political interests or intimidate public officials. item.title: Police invite social media personality Dee One for routine interview
item.description: A former Big Brother Naija housemate and comedian, Aderombi Adedayo, also known as Dee One, has disclosed that he has been invited by the Nigeria Police Force, Force Intelligence Department (FID) for a routine interview. Deeone made this known in a post shared on X on Thursday, where he read out the content of the […] Police invite social media personality Dee One for routine interview

item.title: 2027: Sack Amupitan as INEC chairman – MURIC tells Tinubu
item.description: Ahead of the 2027 general election, the Muslim Rights Concern, MURIC, has asked President Bola Tinubu to immediately remove the Chairman of Independent National Electoral Commission, INEC, Prof. Josiah Amupitan. MURIC declared that Amupitan’s removal is necessary in order to protect the credibility of the forthcoming elections. item.title: Police nab car snatcher, recover stolen vehicle in Akwa Ibom
item.description: Akwa Ibom State Police Command says it has arrested a car snatcher who robbed a bolt driver of his Toyota Corolla vehicle at gunpoint in Uyo. It added that the vehicle was recovered in Ikono, another local government in the state. The Command’s Public Relations Officer, DSP Timfon John, disclosed this in a statement in […] Police nab car snatcher, recover stolen vehicle in Akwa Ibom

item.title: Soldiers engage terrorists, neutralize several ISWAP fighters in Borno
item.description: Nigerian troops have dealt a significant blow to insurgent activities in the North East part of the country following coordinated dawn operations that neutralized several terrorists and recovered arms and ammunition. item.title: Makoko demolition: Palliatives not enough, give residents due compensation – Activist
item.description: Human rights activist, Yemi Adamolekun, has called on the Lagos State Government to give due compensation to residents who are affected by the Makoko demolition.
